breeding.method: hybrid; official page describes it as almost pure sativa

lineage.note: Serious Seeds states the cross is undisclosed. The page discusses ancestry, but the exact pedigree is not fully revealed, so parentage is not inferred.

origin.text: Serious Seeds notes ancestral stock had been cultivated in the United States and describes strong Southeast Asian/Cambodian background plus Afghani influence, while the complete pedigree remains undisclosed.

history.text: Serious Seeds documents multiple breeding revisions; the modern line returned to a more sativa-dominant pattern in the late 1990s and won the 2000 High Times Cannabis Cup sativa category.
